ja363:1.1: Hirin tarantaṃ vijigucchamānaṃ (cfr. Suttanipāta v. p.204-205) tavāham asmī iti bhāsamānaṃ seyyāni kammāni anādiyantaṃ n' eso maman ti iti taṃ vijaññā.
ja363:2.1: Yaṃ hi kayirā taṃ hi vade yaṃ na kayirā na taṃ vade, akarontaṃ bhāsamānaṃ parijānanti paṇḍitā. (J. V.)
ja363:3.1: Na so mitto yo sadā appamatto (= supra p. v..) bhedāsaṃkī randham evānupassī, yasmiñ ca seti urasīva putto sa ve mitto yo abhejjo parehi.
ja363:4.1: Pāmujjakaraṇaṃ ṭhānaṃ pasaṃsāvahanaṃ sukhaṃ phalānisaṃso bhāveti vahanto porisaṃ dhuraṃ.
